about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Automotive Partner
about.description: Mallouka Motors, known for years as Allo Casse Auto, has been serving Tunisia's automotive needs since 2003. We specialize in importing high-quality engines, gearboxes, and spare parts from Europe, providing our customers with reliable solutions for their vehicles.
about.missionText: To provide premium automotive parts and services with unmatched quality and customer service.
about.visionText: To be Tunisia's leading provider of imported automotive parts and mechanical services.

testimonialItems.item3Text: Best place for imported engines in the region. Fair prices and honest business. Will definitely come back.
testimonialItems.item4Text: Outstanding customer service and fast delivery. My order arrived in perfect condition and earlier than expected.
testimonialItems.item5Text: Great experience from start to finish. The team was knowledgeable and helped me choose the right parts for my vehicle.

testimonialItems.item7Text: I have been a loyal customer of Mallouka Motors for years. My father shares a great relationship with the owner, Majdi Feki, and I do too. I bought several articles for my Audi, and the quality is always excellent.

testimonialItems.item9Text: A big thank you to Majdi, the owner, for this great collaboration and his excellent behavior throughout. It is always a pleasure doing business with him.
testimonialItems.item10Text: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Majdi, the owner of Mallouka Motors, for his professionalism, integrity, and the outstanding quality of our collaboration. His team is serious, responsive, and delivers exactly what was promised. A partner I highly recommend.
testimonialItems.item11Text: It has been a pleasure working with Majdi at Mallouka Motors. Professional, honest, and always available to help. I look forward to our next collaboration.
testimonialItems.item12Text: Working with Mallouka Motors has been a great experience. They are so professional and the collaboration is always smooth from start to finish.

faqItems.q1: What types of engines do you import?
faqItems.a1: We import various types of engines including petrol, diesel, and hybrid engines from reputable European sources including France, Belgium, Germany, Italy, and Spain.
faqItems.a2: Yes, we provide professional engine installation services at our mechanical workshop. Our experienced technicians ensure proper installation and testing.
faqItems.a3: We offer warranty coverage on our engines and parts. The warranty terms vary depending on the type of part. Contact us for specific warranty details for your purchase.
faqItems.a4: Shipping times vary depending on the source country and availability. Typically, orders from Europe take 2-4 weeks. We provide estimated delivery times for each order.
faqItems.q5: Do you ship to other countries?
faqItems.a5: Yes, we serve multiple countries including Tunisia, Algeria, Morocco, and others. Contact us to check if we ship to your location.
faqItems.q6: How can I track my order?
faqItems.a6: Once your order is shipped, we provide you with tracking information so you can monitor your shipment's progress.
faqItems.q7: What payment methods do you accept?
faqItems.a7: We accept various payment methods including bank transfers, cash, and mobile payment options. Contact us for more details.
faqItems.a8: Yes, our knowledgeable team is available to provide technical support and answer any questions you may have about our products and services.
